newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy mostly up on new crop exports, wheat down.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy mostly up on new crop exports, wheat down.

text.p: U.S. grain and soy complex futures opening as of 0935 CDT.
WHEAT - Down 1-3/4 to two cents a bushel - Market under pressure from a jump in USDA winter wheat production estimate, traders said.
CORN - Steady to 1/4 cent per bushel lower - Corn futures followed wheat lower but supported by robust export sales, traders said.
SOYBEANS - 3-1/4 cent a bushel higher to one lower - Buying from options pit boosted nearby contracts and new crop export sales pushed new crop months higher, traders said.
SOY PRODUCTS - Soymeal $0.30 lower to $0.50 per ton higher, while soyoil down 0.10 to 0.06 cent per lb.
